title: The Standing Share the Site's Cafe Programme Allows on a Restatement
content:
The share an employer's dining programme allows as a matter of standing on an Employee Meal Account restatement is read from the Workplace Cafe Management Program contract at the account's site and from the number of meal periods its service model serves each day. The broad pickup share is 12 percent and the narrow pickup share is 6 percent.

**Clause.** Where the employer's cafe programme at the account's site stands active and serves two or more meal periods a day, the standing share is the broad pickup share. Where the employer's cafe programme at the account's site stands active and serves one meal period a day, the standing share is the narrow pickup share. Where neither holds, the standing share is nothing.

## The bands

| The cafe contract at the account's site | Meal periods its service model serves each day | Standing share |
|---|---|---|
| Active | 2 or more | 12 percent |
| Active | Exactly 1 | 6 percent |
| Active | None served | Nothing |
| In any other state, or none held at the site | Any | Nothing |

## Points of judgement

Both bands are written for a cafe contract that stands active; a contract that has been suspended, closed or never signed at that site allows no standing share whatever its service model would serve. A service model serving exactly 2 meal periods a day reaches the broad share, since the band reads two or more.

*Hypothetical illustration.* An active cafe contract at the site whose service model serves breakfast and lunch allows a standing share of 12 percent; one serving lunch alone allows 6 percent.
